caption:
106,545 reviews on one twin mattress protector. That's not a fluke.

A twin bed sees more spills, sweat, and accidents than almost any other mattress in the house — kids, guests, dorm moves. A protector only earns six figures of reviews if it actually stops liquid from reaching the mattress underneath.

This one is waterproof and sized for a twin mattress up to 15 inches deep, so it fits thicker pillow-top and memory foam beds without slipping off the corners. At 4.5 stars across 106,545 reviews, the volume itself is the signal — that many people don't leave a rating unless the product does the one thing it promised.

Your mattress stays protected from spills and stains without needing a replacement, and it's $12.99.
